findings.evidence: Protocol page (source1) and leaderboard.json (source2) publish no release identifier/version field; metadata only has total_tasks 102 and last_updated 2026-09-27. Row declares version_status 'published' and version 'opt1-102', but c2 says 'published' requires a maintainer-published release identifier copied into version; absence of such an identifier supports 'snapshot' with a snapshot-<date> version.
findings.repair: Change version_status to 'snapshot' and set version to a snapshot-<date> identity (e.g., snapshot-2026-11-16) unless a maintainer-published release identifier is supplied; otherwise provide that identifier and update version accordingly.

uncertainties: I cannot independently verify SHA-256 hashes, leaderboard transport, or producer qualification; those checks are owner-side.

The row's maintainer label adds '(UC Berkeley)'; the provided protocol excerpt names GSO and authors but does not spell out that affiliation. I did not treat this as a blocker because it is outside the acceptance criteria and the source names GSO.
Wording differences in the metric description are minor paraphrases of the source and were not treated as mismatches.
